# Ahmed Kashif Portfolio

Ahmed Kashif is a Frontend Developer focused on fast, responsive and accessible web interfaces built with React.js, JavaScript, HTML, CSS and Tailwind CSS.

## Main pages

- [Ahmed Kashif Portfolio](https://ahmed-new-portfolio.netlify.app/): Main portfolio with About, Skills, Services, Projects, Process and Contact sections.
- [NovaShop E-Commerce Demo](https://ahmed-new-portfolio.netlify.app/ecommerce): Responsive React shopping interface demo.
